_readme: AirScribe's settings for the .deb install. Every key is described in airscribe.config.json.sample in /opt/airscribe and in /usr/share/doc/airscribe. After a change: systemctl restart airscribe. A non-loopback host needs auth.passwordHash (node /opt/airscribe/tools/make-password.mjs) or auth.tokens.
_stt: The mock engine labels every clip as a mock transcript. Set up a real one from docs/transcription.md.
